newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Nov engineering orders up two pct y/y-VDMA.
newsitem.headline: German Nov engineering orders up two pct y/y-VDMA.

text.p: German November engineering orders rose a real two percent year-on-year, the VDMA industry association said in a statement on Tuesday.
The VDMA added November domestic machinery orders increased by five percent, while foreign orders fell by one percent.
Engineering orders in the September to November period fell four percent year-on-year, domestic orders in the period shed three percent and foreign orders slid five percent.
